title: Magento Migration
meta: Move products, customers and orders to or from Magento, including Magento 1 to 2 upgrades. From $250, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Magento migration for catalog, customers and orders
overview: We move your store data to or from Magento with care. We map your products, categories, customers and past orders to the new system, run a test import first, compare the numbers and then run the final one so nothing changes after you go live. We also handle Magento 1 to Magento 2 data upgrades and moves from Shopify, WooCommerce or BigCommerce. Old URLs get redirects so search results keep working.

pkgs.blurb: A small catalog moved with a test import.
Products and customers moved, with a checked final import.
A full move with orders, content and launch support.

faq: Can you move from Shopify or WooCommerce to Magento?
Yes, and the other way round. We export from the source, map fields to Magento attributes and import in stages. Send the store link and your platform and we confirm what moves cleanly.
Not always. Many platforms store them in forms that the next one cannot read. When that is true, customers reset their password once, and we can prepare the email that tells them how.
Is my store offline during the move?
No. We build and test on a staging copy while your current store keeps selling. For the final import we pick a quiet time, copy only new orders since the test and switch over within a short window.
Can you upgrade Magento 2 versions too?
Version upgrades inside Magento 2 are a separate job and fall under our management service. This page covers data moves between platforms and the Magento 1 to 2 data upgrade.
